jobs.occupation: Backend Software Developer - Team Sports Applications
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

About The Job Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, responsible for applications used in golf, baseball, softball and football. You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React.

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

**Job Requirements

**Required skills:

• 3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills

• Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider

• Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication

• Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles

• Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset

• Experience with Git

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):

• Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)

• Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

**The Office

**We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

**Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

**Where innovation happens

**At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

**Share our Passion!

**Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Do you enjoy turning workplace needs into real solutions and taking projects from idea to implementation? As our new Workspace Specialist, you will combine project leadership with hands-on workspace development in an international environment.

You will lead workplace projects from early concept through implementation, helping transform our global offices into inspiring, functional and future-ready environments.

**

What you will be doing**

As a key part of our Global People & Workspace team, you will help shape workplace environments across Grundfos. You will translate business and employee needs into practical workspace solutions while ensuring alignment with our global Workspace Standards.

Your main responsibilities include:

• 
Lead workplace projects from concept through implementation.

• 
Coordinate stakeholders, suppliers, and consultants throughout the project lifecycle.

• 
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and deliverables.

• 
Ensure alignment with Grundfos Workspace Standards.

• 
Support workplace change management and user adoption activities.

• 
Advise local Facility Management teams globally on implementing Grundfos Workspace Standards.

• 
Balance your time 50/50 between managing larger projects with external architects and independently creating workplace layouts for smaller projects.

• 
Create professional presentations and project materials using Adobe InDesign.

What makes you a great fit

You are structured, proactive and a strong team player who takes ownership, with a practical understanding of workplace needs and the ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

• You have project management experience, preferably within Activity Based Working, workplace, corporate real estate or office fit-out.

• You have experience working with AutoCAD and Revit.

• You have strong stakeholder management skills and are confident working across different countries and organisational levels.

• You collaborate effectively with suppliers, contractors and external consultants.

• You are comfortable working independently and taking projects from idea to implementation.

• You communicate fluently in English and are willing to travel when required.

Why you'll love working here

Day to day, you can look forward to:

• A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support.

• Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities.

• Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering.

• On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth.

Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations.

Join Grundfos, apply today!

jobs.occupation: German-speaking Sales & Customer Success Manager - DACH Market
jobs.description:
Do you want to take our DACH markets to the next level, grow with a fast-moving startup, and join our amazing international team? If building relationships with customers and providing top-level service sounds exciting, you are the one we are looking for! 🚀

Limepack is a fast-growing scale-up in the printed packaging industry. We are on a mission to help small businesses become brands. Our vision is to become the go-to European platform for custom branded food packaging, and we are currently available across 14 countries. 🌍

Join our international team based in Denmark and around the world. Our office is in Frederiksberg, where English is the main language. We enjoy each other’s company both at the office and at occasional events after hours. 💚

As a Limepack Sales & Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in developing the German, Austrian and Swiss markets, maintaining relationships with existing customers, and converting new inbound leads, while working closely with 9 international sales colleagues responsible for different countries.

Our open and friendly work environment will allow you to gain insights into how our business is run, to take part in decision-making, and to have a lot of influence on growing the DACH markets but also on our overall sales strategy. 📈

📋Your responsibilities at Limepack:

• Drive growth in your market: Take ownership of growing sales by identifying commercial opportunities, prioritizing high-value prospects and proactively moving opportunities forward.

• Turn leads into customers: Convert inbound enquiries into orders through proactive calls, consistent follow-up and clear recommendations. Understand what customers need, communicate our value and close the sale.

• Build repeat business: Turn first orders into lasting customer relationships. Stay close to your customers, anticipate their next purchase and actively pursue opportunities to cross-sell, upsell and grow their business with Limepack.

• Develop high-value accounts: Become a trusted takeaway packaging expert for our A Customers. Combine excellent service with a commercial mindset to increase order value, purchase frequency and long-term customer value.

• Collaborate to deliver results: Work closely with product, finance, operations and logistics to deliver a seamless customer experience that supports conversion, retention and growth.

🎓Your qualifications:

• You speak and write German at a native level and communicate confidently in English.

• You have previous sales experience in German, Austrian and Swiss markets, or a Customer Success background with responsibility for revenue growth and conversion.

• You are motivated by measurable results: winning new customers, growing revenue and seeing your actions directly impact sales performance. Targets give you energy and focus. You enjoy spotting opportunities and bringing pace and initiative to move conversations towards a sale.

• Experience with outbound sales and proactive outreach, such as prospecting, cold calling or reactivating inactive accounts, is a plus.

• You are confident in picking up the phone and handling objections. You combine persistence with sound judgment and a clear understanding of the customer’s needs.

• You build strong customer relationships and actively look for ways to turn first orders into repeat business and grow each account.

• You enjoy working towards shared goals in an international team, contributing ideas and sharing what works.

• You work in a structured way, use CRM systems to manage opportunities and follow-ups, and quickly adapt to new digital tools.

• You learn quickly, welcome direct feedback and confidently ask questions or challenge ideas to improve results.

💚 We offer:

A young and international team where your input is valued and can be quickly implemented. You will work with competent, motivated, and engaged colleagues who are not afraid of testing new ideas. We prioritize culture and look for people who want to be part of a friendly and proactive team – and who enjoy joining our events and shared moments outside the office. 🥳

The position is 37 hours per week with salary based on qualifications and previous experience. We have a union agreement with HK. The place of work is our Frederiksberg office with one set day per week where we work from home.

📝 Application:

We review applications continuously, so don’t wait too long to apply! We would ideally like to have our new colleague starting in December.

In case you have any questions or need more information regarding the job position, please contact Elsa (Head of People & Culture) on +45 89 88 86 54. Please apply using the application form. We do not accept CVs or applications by email.

If you don’t meet every single requirement but feel excited about the role, we encourage you to apply anyway. ☺️

jobs.occupation: EPC Procurement Lead, Advanced Bioenergy Fund
jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure?  If so, CIP Terra Technologies Advanced Bioenergy Fund is currently looking for a_n EPC Procurement Lead to join our team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Team

The EPC Procurement Lead will become part of a small and experienced team of professionals contributing to the delivery of large-scale international biogas projects. Our goal is to assemble a motivated, diverse, and skilled team that works to make a meaningful, positive difference for the planet. This position will directly report to the Head of EPC Procurement and will be based in Copenhagen, with frequent travel required in Europe.

Role

As our EPC Procurement Lead, you act as the Project Legal Counsel and provide end‑to‑end legal support for large scale biogas projects, with an emphasis on project development, construction, transactions, and contract management. The role requires direct practical experience leading complex EPC contracts, negotiations, and claims management within an international project setting.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• Develop and implement CAPEX procurement strategies aligned with project development schedules and portfolio priorities.

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and administering complex project documentation, including EPC contracts, supply agreements, service agreements, and related side agreements.

• Act as procurement lead for assigned projects, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, managing internal approval stage gate process

• Oversee commercial negotiations with EPC contractors and key suppliers, including pricing, delivery timelines, warranties, and performance guarantees

• Coordinate with Engineering, insurance and ESG teams on risk allocation, LDs, technical guarantees, and contract interfaces

• Managing contract negotiations with a pragmatic, risk‑based and commercially oriented approach.

• Advising internal stakeholders on contractual structures, risk allocation, and mitigation strategies.

• Ongoing contract management, interpretation, and enforcement throughout the project lifecycle.

• Legal support for M&A transactions, joint ventures, acquisitions, disposals, and portfolio transactions in the biogas sector.

You

The ideal candidate is a fully qualified lawyer with 10+ years of post-qualification experience, gained in‑house or in private practice, with a strong business acumen. You have demonstrated the ability to manage complex sourcing and negotiations, and bring solid commercial judgment with experience in risk allocation and contract structuring.

Moreover, you have demonstrated experience in large, complex renewable energy or infrastructure projects, preferably in an international context.

We look for the following in the candidate:

• Extensive experience with FIDIC contracts, EPC contracts, supply agreements, service agreements, and NDAs.

• Commercial judgment and risk-based decision-making

• Experienced in negotiating complex commercial and project contracts.

• Experience in claims handling and contract management.

• Ability to work effectively in a changing, partially defined environment

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

---

CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion

CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.

About CIP Terra Technologies

CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.

We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.

We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.

Optimized CIP Platform

Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.

We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.

Senior Business Controller

Introduction

Are you driven by strategic business development, and do you have the gravitas to challenge the executive board? Do you want the crucial mandate to translate complex data into business-critical action? Then you are the Senior Business Controller we are looking for in Business Controlling!

We are looking for a commercially astute and proactive Senior Business Partner who sets the direction and serves as a trusted advisor to executive management by translating complex data into clear strategic and operational recommendations that drive our growth.

Your Impact

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have a direct influence on the company's bottom line and strategic direction. You will identify business potential, challenge existing processes, and advise key stakeholders. You will become the vital link ensuring that our strategy is executed and delivers results across operational departments.

Meet Your #Teamlidl

In Business Controlling, we are passionate about creating transparency and challenging the status quo in a dynamic, high-performance environment. You will join a dedicated team of specialists where we value in-depth professional sparring, integrity, and strong team spirit. We are currently transforming the controlling function, actively integrating modern AI agents and self-service solutions to shift our focus from daily operations to strategic advisory.

About the job

We offer a central and highly visible role with a short path from analysis to execution, providing ample opportunity to bring your professional authority into play. You will report directly to the Teamlead in Business Controlling and collaborate closely with the Head of Controlling, the CFO, and the Board of Directors.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Strategic Annual Planning: Driving the content and facilitation of the annual planning process, where you critically challenge, validate, and analyze targets and underlying initiatives.

• Executive Reporting & Analyses: Delivering business-critical and ad-hoc assessments for core functions (including revenue analysis) and preparing sharp, action-oriented management commentaries focusing on deviations and trends.

• Business Optimization: Developing well-founded, strategic recommendations for executive management to optimize operations, alongside evaluating and quality-assuring complex business cases.

• Trusted Advisory: Acting as a proactive sparring partner for the business and crafting compelling decision templates and executive presentations.

• Predictive Forecasting: Performing plausibility checks on planning reports and enriching machine-generated forecast values with your business insight.

• Performance Steering: Leading profitability analysis projects and setting the agenda for management performance meetings.

• Digital Transformation: Driving the development of next-generation controlling tools and empowering the business to autonomously utilize self-service BI and AI agents.

About you

About You

We are looking for a trustworthy profile with significant analytical capacity, strong commercial intuition, and natural executive presence. You thrive at the intersection of deep-dive data analysis and persuasive executive-level communication, possessing the diplomatic tact required to drive change across the organization.

We also expect you to have:

• Solid Professional Foundation: A relevant master’s degree combined with senior-level experience in cross-functional business partnering and strategic business analysis.

• Advanced Data Understanding: Broad experience in evaluating complex data structures, quality-assuring advanced forecasts, and proficiency in modern BI environments.

• Business Enablement: A proven track record of evaluating complex business cases and the ability to methodically elevate data-driven decision-making across operational departments.

• Executive Communication: Outstanding communication skills and full professional proficiency in Danish, English, and German (a strict requirement). You effortlessly translate complex data into clear, strategic messages for top management.

We offer

• A data-driven and challenging position with broad cross-functional exposure across controlling.

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

• Limitless career opportunities and professional challenges.

• Option for a health insurance package.

• Discount schemes across a wide range of providers within travel, shopping, culture, fitness, and more.

**

Headquarters in the heart of Aarhus**

We have a large, innovative headquarters located at Godsbanen in Aarhus. As an employee, you will have access to:

• Free fitness center.

• In-house massage service.

• A healthy canteen offering breakfast, lunch, and convenient take-away dinner options – all with a minimum of 30% organic ingredients.

• The opportunity to join social activities such as rooftop morning yoga, running club, family days, and Friday bars.

The recruitment process

Feel free to simply send your CV along with a few lines about your motivation for the job! We know how much time and energy job hunting takes, so make it easy on yourself and skip the traditional cover letter.

As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we reserve the right to close the job posting early—saving you from spending time applying if we have already initiated the interview process or found the right candidate.

During the recruitment process, you can expect: screening, a phone interview, a job interview, and potentially a case study.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact our recruiter, Johanne Rasmussen, at +45 60 34 02 38 on weekdays between 09:00 and 14:00, or by sending an email to jobilidlhq@lidl.dk.

Apply today! - Det betaler sig!

Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Start date: February/March 2027

Duration: 6 months

Work Model: Flexible working hours (10–15 hours per week), arranged around studies

**About The Job

**As an Oncology Medical Affairs Student Worker, you will support Sanofi's North Europe Oncology Medical team in mapping the oncology landscape, particularly in solid tumours, and contributing to real-world evidence (RWE) activities. You will gain hands-on experience in Medical Affairs, working with scientific information, treatment guidelines and research projects that support efforts to improve the lives of patients with cancer.

Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Research and organise information on national and international oncology treatment guidelines, relevant organisations and key healthcare stakeholders.

• Support oncology landscape mapping, particularly in solid tumours, including identifying relevant guidelines and potential gaps.

• Monitor updates to treatment guidelines, scientific publications and medical congresses, preparing clear summaries for the team.

• Support real-world evidence activities, including literature searches, mapping data sources and registries, study documentation and project tracking.

• Assist with real-world evidence governance activities and the preparation of study overviews and presentations.

• Support the Medical Affairs team with research, analysis, insight gathering and preparation of internal materials.

• Create and maintain structured databases, stakeholder maps and project trackers in line with compliance requirements.

**About You

**To excel in this role you will need to have:

• Currently enrolled in a Master's degree programme in Medicine, Pharmacy, Biomedicine, Public Health, Health Sciences, or a related field.

• Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both English and Danish.

• An interest in oncology, Medical Affairs and real-world evidence.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organise, interpret and summarise complex scientific information.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience using scientific literature databases such as PubMed is an advantage.

• A structured, curious and proactive approach to work, with the ability to collaborate effectively with others.

**About Sanofi

**We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

**Why choose us?

**

• Stretch your skills through apprenticeships, internships, graduate programs, and international experiences that grow with you.

• Learn from inspiring mentors and collaborative teams while contributing to real projects that shape the future of healthcare.

• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

• Grow in a purpose-driven company where your voice matters and your work helps improve millions of lives.

• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.

• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date should we receive a sufficient number of applications.

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. If you want to work in an AI-first environment, help redefine how work is done in an industry, and be part of a team that's changing an entire industry, we'd love to have you on board.

**🤩 About The Role

**We are looking for Senior Account Executive for the DACH market who loves the chase, the close and the craft. You’ll own a territory and build your own pipeline of high-value targets, with SDR support, and booming inbound channel feeding you qualified opportunities. You call the shots on where to hunt, who to warm, and how to win. We’ll back you with marketing air cover, product firepower, and leadership you can trust for support and development. For someone ambitious, this is a genuine opportunity to be a founding AE for the DACH market and support building All Gravy in Berlin.

**🎯 What You Will Do

**

• Create and run your target list of dream logos in our ICP. Name them, map them, multi-thread them.

• Work a blended pipe: your self-sourced opportunities plus BDR-sourced meetings you turn into revenue.

• Full cycle everything: discovery → tailored demo → value proof → commercial design → close → high-five.

• Build business cases that make budget holders nod and sign (ROI, payback, the whole nine yards).

• Feedback like a pro: turn deal learnings into sharper messaging, better product bets, and smoother process.

**🙌 You’ll thrive here if you…

**

• You speak excellent German and English, and are based in Copenhagen.

• 5+ years of SaaS sales under your belt, fluent in consultative selling, and MEDPICC. Psst... If you’ve sold into hospitality, we’re listening even harder.

• You’re curious, ambitious, disciplined, and self-driven.

• Are owner-minded. You don’t wait for leads, you create momentum and you love a clean CRM.

• Can navigate complex cycles and senior stakeholders, you’re credible in the boardroom and fun.

• Are data-curious and coachable. You test, learn, and iterate faster than most people.

**💎 Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

BI & Financial Controller

Introduction

Are you driven by financial controlling, and are you passionate about digitalizing manual processes? Do you want to build the bridge between manual operations and the data-driven decision-making foundation of the future? Then you are the BI & Financial Controller  we are looking for!

We are seeking a commercially and technically strong BI & Financial Controller whose primary mission is to shape the backbone of our modern corporate steering. You will bridge deep financial expertise with modern data technologies to eliminate heavy manual routines and build an automated, reliable platform for executive leadership.

Your Impact

As our BI & Financial Controller, you will take ownership of our current manual reporting routines with a clear mandate: to automate and digitalize them. While we operate extensively within concepts and guidelines provided by our international headquarters, you will play a crucial local role. Your impact is felt directly as you push the department toward more data-driven solutions, acting as the vital link between the business, data, and executive management to ensure proactive steering.

Meet Your Team

In Controlling & Analytics, we are facing an exciting transformation journey. We are not fully digitalized yet, but we anticipate and are preparing for this imminent change. You will join a dedicated team where we work determinedly to strengthen our own capacity to develop data-driven solutions. We value professional excellence highly, and we are passionate about actively transforming our field from reactive reporting into proactive product design.

About the job

About the Job

We offer a hybrid and developmental role (Headquarters / Hybrid) where you must thrive at the intersection of daily manual operations and forward-looking automation. You will be responsible for elevating our reporting standards and empowering the organization for a new digital reality.

Your primary tasks will be:

• Operational Reporting: Managing and executing the end-to-end production of daily, weekly, and monthly management reporting packages using standard corporate templates and distribution workflows.

• Automation & Data Ownership: Identifying automation potential across current finance processes and developing digital controlling solutions (KPI frameworks and interactive dashboards).

• KPI Architecture & Financial Steering: Translating strategic corporate goals into measurable, consistent end-to-end driver trees and data-driven performance steering models.

• Organizational Enablement: Empowering controlling colleagues and operational business units to adopt self-service analytics through hands-on training sessions and best-practice concepts.

• Executive Presentations: Translating BI dashboard outputs and KPI trends into clean, executive-ready presentations and ad-hoc analyses for internal leadership.

About you

About You

We are looking for a profile who enjoys having their hands in the engine room. You do not mind handling and taking ownership of the current manual reporting tasks, but your true motivation lies in eliminating them through smart solutions. You are analytically sharp, possess a creative mindset, and have a genuine enthusiasm for technological innovation.

We also expect you to have:

• Solid Professional Foundation: A university degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification, combined with solid professional experience at the intersection of Finance, Data Analytics, and Controlling.

• Financial Expertise: A sound understanding of core corporate steering concepts (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, value-driver trees) and the ability to translate complex financial dynamics into actionable KPI frameworks.

• Technology & BI Stack: Proficiency with modern BI platforms (e.g., Strategy) and coding (e.g., SQL, BigQuery)

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in English is required to ensure seamless collaboration across our cross-functional and international teams. German skills are an advantage, though not a requirement

We offer

• A dynamic, dedicated, and informal work environment within an international retail group.

The recruitment process

jobs.occupation: Full Stack Software Engineer, Android Transactions
jobs.description:
About The Job

Flatpay is enabling merchants to simply and effectively accept payments in-store and online. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe. 100,000+ merchants rely on us today, and we are just getting started.

Every day, merchants take card payments on Flatpay terminals, and the Android Transactions team is behind them. We own the software that runs on those terminals and the backend that connects them to the rest of Flatpay.

We are looking for a full stack engineer who is at home on both sides. On Android you will work on the apps that run on our terminals, including the app that lets a POS drive the terminal and the app that takes the payment itself. On the backend you will work on the Terminal API, the service that connects terminals, POS systems and the Flatpay platform.

You will take real ownership, with freedom to drive technical decisions and a direct impact on how payments are made at a company that has gone from startup to unicorn at record speed.

What you’ll do

• 
Build and maintain the Android apps that run on our payment terminals, including the payment and POS-connectivity apps, using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Hilt

• 
Develop and evolve the Terminal API backend in Java and Spring Boot

• 
Own features end to end across terminal, backend and infrastructure, from discovery through production

• 
Work with real payment hardware: integrate with the terminal vendor SDKs, debug on physical devices and make payment flows robust

Who you are

• 
3+ years of professional software engineering experience

• 
Experience building Android apps in Kotlin, ideally with Jetpack Compose, coroutines and dependency injection (Hilt or Dagger)

• 
Experience building backend services in Java and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, JPA and relational databases

• 
Understanding of what makes mobile and device software reliable: lifecycle, background work, retries and release management

• 
A habit of writing well-tested code and finding root causes in production issues

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills

• 
Any experience with fintech, payments, POS or embedded and device-level Android would be a plus

We don’t expect experience with every technology listed below. We’re looking for engineers who can learn quickly and help us build great products.

Android (terminal apps)

• 
Kotlin, Coroutines, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, WorkManager

• 
AWS IoT / MQTT, terminal vendor SDKs (PAX)

Backend (Terminal API)

• 
Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, MySQL, Redis

• 
REST APIs, OpenAPI, OpenFeign, webhooks

• 
AWS IoT, SQS, S3, KMS; MQTT-based device messaging

Platform & Delivery

• 
GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Docker, AWS ECS, Terraform

• 
Feature flags (LaunchDarkly), Esper device management, Sentry, New Relic

Why Flatpay?

As part of our team, you’ll join 2,600+ passionate Flatpayers dedicated to shaping the future of payments.

We offer an inclusive and diverse environment where engineers of all backgrounds are trusted with ownership, encouraged to make an impact, and supported in growing their craft.

Our engineering teams work together from our Herlev office in the greater Copenhagen area. We believe that close collaboration, quick feedback loops, and solving problems side-by-side help us build better products, move faster, and create a stronger engineering culture.

We also provide plenty of perks including free slush ice, an on-site gym, a fully equipped gamer room, and much more.

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Near public transit

Near public transit

Free office snacks

Free office snacks

Paid holiday

Paid holiday

Free coffee / tea

Free coffee / tea

Work life balance

Work life balance

Flexible working hours

Flexible working hours

See all 18 benefits

Working at

Flatpay

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors.  What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results.  As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate.  We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

jobs.occupation: MCO is searching for a Project and Community Manager
jobs.description:
Help us shape the future of media and technology.

The media industry is changing faster than ever. AI, new technologies and changing audience habits are transforming how we create, distribute and consume content.

At Media City Odense (MCO), we’re bringing together the people and organisations who want to shape what comes next.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious, creative and hands-on Project & Community Manager to join our team in Odense and help take MCO to the next level.

A small team. Big ambitions.

Media City Odense is a growing innovation hub and community connecting some of Denmark’s leading media companies, technology businesses, startups, researchers and educational institutions.

Founded by TV 2 Denmark, JFM, TV 2 Fyn and the University of Southern Denmark, we’ve built a strong foundation for collaboration, innovation and knowledge sharing. And we’re just getting started.

Our ambition is to become Denmark’s leading national hub for media technology and innovation. A place where new ideas turn into real projects, where talent meets opportunity, and where the industry comes together to develop the solutions of tomorrow.

From our annual MediaTech Festival to industry events, innovation projects and new partnerships, we’re building a community that creates value all year round.

And that’s where you come in.

As our new Project & Community Manager, you’ll play a central role in turning ideas and ambitions into activities, experiences and tangible results.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Event Manager and the wider MCO community, taking ownership of projects while helping develop and strengthen our organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Project management: Plan, coordinate and execute projects and initiatives, from the first idea to the final delivery.

• Events & experiences: Help develop and deliver workshops, networking events, industry sessions and our annual MediaTech Festival.

• Community & relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with our members, partners and stakeholders, ensuring they experience real value from being part of MCO.

• Marketing & communications: Create engaging content for our website, newsletters, social media and other communication channels, including basic visual and graphic content.

• Business development: Contribute ideas, identify opportunities and help develop new initiatives that support MCO’s growth and ambitions.

• Making things happen: Keep projects, partners and priorities moving forward, including the practical details that make the difference.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to put your own ideas into action, take responsibility and make a visible impact on the organisation.

Who are you?

We’re looking for someone who combines structure with creativity, initiative with execution, and professionalism with a healthy dose of curiosity.

You enjoy working with people, you’re comfortable taking ownership, and you don’t need a detailed instruction manual to get started.

Ideally, you:

• Have experience with project management, events, communications, community building or a related field.

• Are highly organised, proactive and comfortable managing several projects at once.

• Have strong communication skills and can create engaging written and visual content.

• Have a good eye for design and are comfortable using digital tools to produce presentations, social media graphics and marketing materials.

• Enjoy building relationships and working with people across different organisations and industries.

• Are curious about technology, AI, innovation and the future of media.

• Communicate confidently in both Danish and English.

• Thrive in a small team where responsibilities are broad, decisions are made quickly and everyone contributes.

Experience from the media or tech industry is an advantage, but not a requirement. We’re just as interested in your mindset, initiative and ability to deliver as we are in your CV.

What do we offer?

At MCO, you’ll join a small, dedicated team with ambitious plans and the freedom to help shape how we achieve them. You’ll get:

• Real influence: An opportunity to shape projects, activities and the future development of MCO.

• An exciting network: Direct access to leading media companies, technology innovators, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.

• Variety and responsibility: A broad role where no two weeks look quite the same.

• Room to grow: Opportunities to develop professionally, take ownership and explore new ideas.

• A collaborative culture: An informal working environment built on trust, initiative, curiosity and a shared ambition to make a difference.

We’re based in central Odense, working at the intersection of media, technology and innovation, with a growing network across Denmark and beyond.

Ready to join us?

We’d love to hear from you.

Send your CV and a short application telling us who you are, what motivates you and why you’d be a great fit for Media City Odense.

Apply by email: thhah@mediacityodense.dk

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, and expect to complete the recruitment process during November 2026.

The position is full-time, based in Odense, with a start date to be agreed upon.

Come help us build what’s next.

We are an experience innovation and digital transformation consultancy. We are responsible for the end-to-end product development for some of the biggest brands in the world. We build innovative AI-driven digital experiences used by millions of customers across retail, e-commerce, finance, automotive and other sectors. Operating across five continents with over 6,000 innovators in twenty-two countries, we help organizations reimagine the way they connect with their customers and transform their business operations.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and innovation we drive

• Our Values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The Role:

Valtech Denmark is looking for new enterprise clients. You will be the person that will help win them.

As our Executive Business Developer, you will showcase to Danish enterprise leaders Valtech’s Intelligent Enterprise proposition which connects AI, data, technology, customer experience and operating models to deliver tangible business outcomes.

This is not a conventional sales role. You hunt like a seller, think like a management consultant, use AI and data in your own work and bring the right colleagues in early. You are relentless about results, and you never make the sale about yourself.

You report to the Managing Director, Valtech Nordics, and work day to day with colleagues in strategy, data and AI, experience design, technology and delivery, and with Valtech’s international network of expertise.

Role Responsibilities:

• Own new logo acquisition: identify, engage and win new enterprise clients across Denmark, running every stage from target selection and first contact to pitch, negotiation and close

• Build and execute a GTM plan focused on high-value target accounts and priority industries

• Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CIOs, CMOs, CDOs and other senior decision-makers

• Open every conversation with a hypothesis about the client’s business, not our service catalogue, and link AI opportunities to the data, processes, technology and organizational capabilities needed to realize value

• Pull strategy, data and AI, design, technology and delivery colleagues in early, and lead pursuits and RFP responses through influence rather than ownership of every idea

• Co-sell with strategic partners (Adobe, Salesforce, Sitecore, Optimizely, Contentful, hyperscalers, etc.), including joint AI-led propositions

• Use AI and data across prospecting, meeting preparation, proposals and forecasting, and keep Salesforce disciplined so the pipeline and forecast can be trusted

• Deliver against your agreed new-business target and represent Valtech at industry events and partner activations

What we expect of you:

• Hunter: You open doors instead of waiting for leads, and can say exactly what you personally contributed to each win.

• Orchestrator: You compete on outcomes, not ego, and share credit with the specialists you involve.

• Consultant mindset: You ask sharp questions, challenge assumptions and frame problems that matter to the business.

• AI and data native: You use AI in your own work, know where it fails and tie it to real business problems, as a commercially credible bridge rather than a technical specialist.

• Energy builder: You bring pace, optimism and a bias for action, backed by a plan and real client conversations, not slogans.

Must have Qualifications:

• Proven track record winning net-new enterprise logos in a digital agency or consulting environment, with a clear view of your personal contribution

• Experience selling complex, multi-million euro engagements across digital experience, data, technology and AI-enabled solutions

• A strong network in Denmark, ideally including senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships

• Exceptional consultative sales skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into impactful digital and AI-enabled strategies

• Practical understanding of how AI and data apply in commercial and customer experience contexts, including where they fall short

• Deep understanding of one or more key industries (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences)

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex client organizations and mobilize internal specialists

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with fluency in Danish and English

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a permanent position based in Denmark.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

• Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs

• Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.
